entities.name: Notification procedure
entities.description: Procedure used by the network to inform the UE about events relevant for upper layers using an EPS bearer context or procedure transaction.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that receives notifications from the network.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network entity that initiates the notification procedure.

entities.name: EPS bearer context
entities.description: Context used by upper layers for which notifications may be relevant.

entities.name: Procedure transaction
entities.description: Ongoing transaction for which notifications may be relevant.

entities.name: PDN connection
entities.description: Condition where a PDN connection exists, enabling notification procedure initiation.

entities.name: UE supports notification procedure
entities.description: Precondition that the UE must have indicated support for the notification procedure.

relations.description: Notification procedure informs the UE about relevant events.
Notification procedure is relevant for upper layers using EPS bearer context.
Notification procedure is relevant for ongoing procedure transactions.
Notification procedure requires that UE has indicated support.
Notification procedure can be initiated while PDN connection exists.
